name: UK terrorism threat level
summary: UK national terrorism threat level Severe, meaning an attack is highly likely; no change found as of 21 Nov
state: The UK national terrorism threat level is Severe, meaning an attack is highly likely, after the Joint Terrorism Analysis Centre raised it from Substantial on 30 Apr 2026 following a terror attack in Golders Green, citing a wider rise in the threat (Home Office; Lancashire Police). The government's terrorism guidance still gives the level as Severe, and searches on 21 Nov found no announced change.
for_you: Stay alert in crowded places and report suspicious activity to the police or the anti-terrorism hotline. MI5 and ProtectUK publish guidance on the threat level and what it means.
rubric_hit: Alert: national threat level Severe (raised by JTAC 30 Apr 2026)
